verdicts.quote: "Olyvar's dead, ser," the cook said, before Marro could find his tongue. Flat, not unkind. "Fever. Ten days back. We put him in the ground out by the wall."
verdicts.reason: Olyvar never appears; the fetch request is corrected in the fiction by stating he died of fever and is buried by the wall.
